tickets.text: The ticket's words drop the impulse condition: the hourly close above bar_high should read 'while elder holds 7+', since the permission event is one bar old (elder_5d [3, 4, 0, 0, 8], C3, C4).

Trigger h1_close_above:bar_high buys a break of the prior high. elder_5d [7, 10, 10, 10, 7] is green going away on the last bar (C4), mp_state FADING; Elder buys the pullback into the rising average, not in front of price (C10).

KEEP stands, but the add trigger close_above:bar_high on D adds on strength the session after a single-bar drop, elder_5d [6, 9, 9, 10, 7], Elder's profit-taking bar (R7, C4). Elder adds on the pullback into value (C10).

ADVANCE on h1_close_above:bar_high acts before the pullback has completed: elder_5d [10, 10, 7, 7, 7] is a pullback in progress with no transition yet, H1 LH/LL (C3, C4). Elder buys the value reclaim, not the prior-high break (C10).

Trigger h1_close_above:bar_high after the Creek pull-in buys a prior-high break, while elder_5d [7, 7, 10, 10, 7] shows green going away on the last bar, profit-taking not a buy (C4); my quoted line buys at value (C10).
Trigger h1_close_above:bar_high buys above yesterday's high on a plateau, elder_5d [6, 10, 10, 10, 10], summer (C20); Elder bids slightly under the rising average, not above the prior high (C10).
Trigger h1_close_above:bar_high buys a prior-high break after a last-bar drop, elder_5d [7, 10, 7, 10, 7], green going away (C4); Elder's entry is the pullback into the rising average (C10).

ADVANCE on h1_close_above:pivot_high buys a range breakout on a last-bar drop, elder_5d [7, 7, 10, 10, 7], which is profit-taking (C4). Elder's entry is the pullback into value, not the jump over the range top (C10).
